column8: classic: faithful port of the xscreensaver original. enhanced: same hack with anti-aliasing, soft lighting, glow and smooth palettes. auto: enhanced on GPUs that can afford it, classic otherwise.
Time scale of the animation. 1 matches the original xscreensaver pace.
Seed for the random choices (0 = new every launch). The same seed repeats the same run.
mesh: framed faces; solid; stellated: faces grow points; stellated2: faces dent inward; random: changes each cycle (xscreensaver -mode).
Number of frequencies to cycle through; the highest has 20 x 4^(count-1) faces (xscreensaver -count).
Drift the sphere around the screen (xscreensaver -wander).
Strength of the soft glow around bright areas (enhanced style only). 0 turns the glow pass off.
